name: dprint
description: Pluggable code formatter with TypeScript, JSON, Markdown support

tools.description: High-performance code formatter with plugin architecture
tools.usage:
dprint fmt src/ # Format specific directory
dprint check --diff # Show formatting differences without applying
dprint fmt --config custom.json *.ts # Use custom configuration
dprint init --type typescript # Initialize TypeScript configuration
dprint upgrade # Update plugins to latest versions
